claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch because aggregate readiness is positive, and the remaining exposed health-plan benefits support weakness is adequately handled by explicit pre-launch model-card disclosure plus staged monitoring and rollback rather than approved risk acceptance.
specific_concerns: The policy requires disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, but the record provided does not show that the required pre-launch disclosure has actually been completed.
The affected health-plan benefits support segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort, so rollout percentage, monitoring, and rollback do not independently satisfy the policy predicate.
The risk-acceptance draft is unapproved and does not cover the exposed segment, so it cannot serve as governance cover.
The actor's recommended action is 'certify_model', but the admissible evidence only supports a conditional certification posture if disclosure is actually made before launch.
unsupported_claims: Any unconditional claim that the model is already ready for certification on the present record.
Any claim that rollout controls alone mitigate the model-card weakness sufficiently for policy compliance.
Any claim that the current draft risk acceptance provides approved coverage for the exposed health-plan benefits support segment.
evidence_requests: Produce the final pre-launch model-card or equivalent disclosure artifact showing the health-plan benefits support limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Produce approval or release-governance evidence that certification is conditioned on that disclosure being present before launch.
If disclosure will not be made, produce an approved risk-acceptance record that explicitly addresses the health-plan benefits support exposure in the initial rollout cohort.
Produce the launch configuration or audience controls if the affected segment is in fact excluded, since the current evidence says it is not.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence shows the required pre-launch disclosure was completed, the verdict could move to compliant_with_caveats or compliant depending on the strength of the release record.
If admissible evidence instead shows the affected segment is excluded from rollout, rollout controls plus monitoring could materially improve supportability.
If approved risk acceptance explicitly covering the exposed segment exists, that could satisfy the policy alternative to disclosure.
Absent disclosure completion, exclusion, or approved risk acceptance, certification remains insufficiently supported under the stated policy.
